page.overview:
Who is Dennis?

Kadasha (daughter) Mateo (stepson) Unnamed Son

Dennis is an African-American father and the head of a mixed family from Oakland, California.

Dennis was portrayed by American actor André Holland in the 2019 short film Battle at Big Rock.

Dennis is from Oakland, California. An African-American, he was once in a relationship with an unknown African-American woman with whom he had a daughter named Kadasha. Under unknown circumstances, he became a single father and raised Kadasha on his own.
